gaps: P0: none. P2: only a modest engraving (#11); #9 is a 1657 reissue of a Braun and Hogenberg plate, #10 is a single building with an uncertain 1735–1805 date. P3: no general view; #13 is the best available.
notes: #32 is Granada, Nicaragua (excluded). #11 dated 1694 per Rijksmuseum (Theatrum Hispaniae series, probably Pieter van den Berge, about 1694–1708). #21 publisher not named in its record; neighboring LoC records in the same series credit Photoglob Co.; LoC date given as 1899. #13 is probably by John Frederick Lewis but the record names no artist. #12 Chénot lithograph skipped: dated only 1800–1899. #2 (large colored plate with cartouche) is probably vol. 5 (1598), not 1572 as Commons says, so #4 used for period 1.
